drafts.title: No gas cap, no oil changes (short, ready)
drafts.body:
My Model Y has no gas cap to forget, no oil changes, no spark plugs. Tires still cost money, so it's not free. But AAA figures an EV like mine runs about $550 a year less in maintenance and repairs than a gas SUV.

What's the dumbest repair bill you ever paid?
bullets: AAA 2026 Your Driving Costs: compact SUV maintenance, repair and tires $1,402/yr EV vs $1,954/yr gas, about $552 less.
Tires can wear faster on a heavier EV; saying so builds trust.

drafts.title: Medicare: AI explains, Plan Finder decides (short, ready)
drafts.window: Tue 11 AM or Mon 1 PM MT
drafts.body:
Medicare open enrollment ends December 7. AI is great at explaining a confusing letter in plain English. Don't let it pick your plan, though. Testers caught these tools giving confident wrong answers.

Compare plans free on Medicare's Plan Finder, or call 1-800-MEDICARE.
bullets: Open enrollment Oct 15 to Dec 7 (CMS).
Louise Norris tested AI tools and found confident errors, including a wrong Colorado answer (AHCJ, Oct 2026).

drafts.title: Warm it up while plugged in (short, ready)
drafts.window: First cold morning, or Fri 12-1 PM MT
drafts.body:
Cold mornings are coming to Grand Junction. Simple EV trick: warm the car up while it's still plugged in, so the heat comes from the wall, not the battery. Heated seat on, cabin a little cooler.

AAA found range can drop up to 39% at 20 degrees with the heat cranked.
bullets: AAA 2026 lab test: up to 39% range loss at 20F with cabin at 72F.
DOE: precondition while plugged in, use heated seats.

drafts.title: First cold morning in Grand Junction: what % did I lose overnight?
drafts.ocr_why: Honest first-hand winter numbers calm the #1 fear older buyers have; strong only with his real % and temperature.
drafts.window: Post the morning it's actually cold and he catches a reading; otherwise Fri 12-1 PM or Sat 6 PM MT.
drafts.angle: Winter is here on the Western Slope. Calm, real cold-weather EV numbers from an owner, plus the simple fix.
bullets: AAA 2026 lab test: EVs lost 39% of range on average at 20F vs 75F with the cabin at 72F. In 95F heat, only about 8.5%.
KBB (Oct 27): cold batteries charge slower at fast chargers, sometimes twice as long; precondition first.
DOE tips: precondition while plugged in, use heated seats over cabin heat, park in a garage if you can.
Keep the 39% framed as 'up to' (lab range with cabin heat), not his commute.
drafts.body:
"[___]% gone overnight. First real cold morning in Grand Junction, [___] degrees.

AAA tested EVs at 20 degrees and found they can lose up to 39% of their range with the heat cranked. That sounds scary. Here's what it looks like in real life for me: [what it actually meant for my day ___].

My fix is simple. Warm the car up while it's still plugged in, so the battery heat comes from the wall, not the battery. Heated seat on, cabin a little cooler.

[photo: app showing % and outside temp]

What's your winter range trick?"
drafts.pixel: Breath-in-the-air shot by the car, 10-15 seconds: "First cold morning. Here's what the battery did."
drafts.target: A big EV account posting AAA cold-weather numbers (Not a Tesla App, Electrek), or a Colorado EV owner.

drafts.title: Medicare open enrollment: AI can explain it. It can't pick your plan.
drafts.ocr_why: High save value for 55+ and their adult kids, AI-for-normal-people lane, no scam angle; less of a reply magnet than F1.
drafts.window: Tue 11 AM MT (best weekly slot), or Mon 1 PM. Enrollment ends Dec 7.
drafts.angle: Use AI like a patient friend to translate the confusing letter, then check the real numbers on Medicare's own free tool.
bullets: Open enrollment runs Oct 15 to Dec 7 (CMS).

Health policy analyst Louise Norris tested AI tools and got confident answers with numerous errors, including old poverty guidelines and a wrong Colorado subsidy answer (Association of Health Care Journalists, Oct 2026).
AI can't pull real premium and drug-cost data; Medicare's Plan Finder can, and it has a new AI-powered drug search.
Free human help: 1-800-MEDICARE or a local SHIP counselor.
drafts.body:
"$0. That's what it costs to compare Medicare plans on Medicare's own website. Open enrollment ends December 7.

Here's how I'd use AI on it. Take a photo of that confusing letter and ask it to explain it like I'm a normal person. [what I'd ask it ___]. It's great at that.

What I would not do is let it pick the plan. A health policy expert tested these AI tools and they gave confident answers that were flat wrong, including about Colorado.

So: AI explains, Plan Finder decides. And if you'd rather talk to a person, 1-800-MEDICARE is free.

Would your parents know where to start?"
drafts.pixel: At the kitchen table holding a stack of mail: "Here's how I'd use AI on this without trusting it blindly."
drafts.target: @MedicareGov open enrollment post, or a big AI-for-everyday-people account.
